fact: Law 2020-015 on combating information manipulation, in force, prohibits in article 7 publishing 'montages' of a person's words or images with intent to harm, punishable by 3 months to 1 year in prison and a fine of MRU 60,000 to 100,000; the analysis says it is unclear whether this covers deepfakes.
title: Analyse du pays : Mauritanie
